summary_zh: 本页为绘本《动物宝宝》的封面，展示了一只在花丛中仰头嚎叫的小狼崽，背景为绿色草地和粉色花朵，配有书名、作者、译者及出版社信息。

page_text_ocr_zh:
看, 动物宝宝!
Look, a baby!
有的动物宝宝和妈妈一起生活在冰天雪地的世界里。
Some babies snuggle on snowy
sheets of ice.
page_text_en:
Look, a baby!
Some babies snuggle on snowy
sheets of ice.
summary_zh: 本页展示了一只北极熊宝宝趴在妈妈背上，母子俩在冰雪中休息，文字说明有些动物宝宝和妈妈一起生活在冰天雪地的世界里。

page_text_ocr_zh:
有的动物宝宝和兄弟姐妹们挤在温暖、舒适的小窝里。
Some babies cuddle in warm, cozy dens.
还有的动物宝宝把家安在高高的树上。
Others live in nests high in trees.
page_text_en:
Some animal babies cuddle with their brothers and sisters in warm, cozy dens.
Some babies cuddle in warm, cozy dens.
Others live in nests high in trees.
Others live in nests high in trees.
summary_zh: 本页展示了两种动物宝宝的居住环境：左侧是挤在温暖小窝里的狼崽和鬣狗宝宝，右侧是住在高树上的鸟宝宝和成年鸟。

page_text_ocr_zh:
有的动物宝宝在长满青草的山坡或平原上学习走路，练习奔跑。
Some babies toddle and trot on grassy hills and plains.
哗啦啦！
Splash!
有的动物宝宝在蓝蓝的大海里游泳，还时不时地跳出水面。
And some swim and leap through wavy seas.
page_text_en:
Some animal babies learn to walk and run on grassy hills or plains.
Some babies toddle and trot on grassy hills and plains.
Splash!
Splash!
Some animal babies swim in the blue sea and sometimes leap out of the water.
And some swim and leap through wavy seas.
summary_zh: 本页展示了两种动物宝宝的活动场景：左侧是一只小犀牛在草地上练习奔跑，右侧是海豚和海牛在大海中游泳并跃出水面，文字说明了动物宝宝在陆地和海洋中的不同活动方式。

page_text_ocr_zh:
对小鸟来说，蛾子
可是一顿美餐哦！
喂我！喂我！
Feed me!
和你一样，所有的动物宝宝都需要
吃东西才能长大。鸟爸爸和鸟妈妈叼着
美味的虫子或鱼儿回来，鸟宝宝一下子
就把食物吃掉了。
All baby animals have to eat to grow,
just like you. Baby birds gobble up
food their parents bring to them,
such as tasty bugs or fish.
鱼、蚯蚓和
虫子，你会选哪
样当晚餐？
你能把嘴
巴张得多大？
鸟妈妈为
自己的小宝宝
带来了美味的
青蛙。
一看到美味的虫子，小
鸟就把嘴巴张得大大的——快
给我吃！快给我吃！
有的动物宝宝是哺乳动物，它们喝
妈妈的乳汁长大。熊、猎豹和鲸鱼都是
哺乳动物，我们人类也是哺乳动物哦！
Some baby animals are called mammals.
They drink milk from their mother. Bears,
cheetahs, and whales are mammals. So
are humans.
在这张
照片里，你
看到了几只
猎豹宝宝？
虎鲸宝宝在和妈
妈蹭鼻子呢！
这只熊妈妈要

page_text_en:
For little birds, moths
are a delicious meal!
Feed me! Feed me!
Feed me!
Just like you, all baby animals need to eat
in order to grow. Bird dads and bird moms bring back
delicious bugs or fish, and the baby birds gobble it up right away.
All baby animals have to eat to grow,
just like you. Baby birds gobble up
food their parents bring to them,
such as tasty bugs or fish.
Fish, earthworms, and
bugs — which would you choose
for dinner?
How wide can you open your mouth?
The bird mom brings
a tasty frog for her little babies.
As soon as the little bird sees a delicious bug, it
opens its mouth wide — quick, feed me! Feed me!
Some baby animals are mammals. They grow by drinking
their mother's milk. Bears, cheetahs, and whales are mammals.
We humans are mammals too!
Some baby animals are called mammals.
They drink milk from their mother. Bears,
cheetahs, and whales are mammals. So
are humans.
In this photo,
how many
cheetah cubs
can you see?
The baby orca is rubbing noses with its mom!
This bear mom has to feed 3 baby bears. Do you
have any brothers or sisters?
summary_zh: 本页介绍了动物宝宝如何进食，包括鸟类宝宝吃虫子和鱼、哺乳动物宝宝喝母乳，并通过图片和文字展示了鸟妈妈喂食、猎豹宝宝和熊宝宝与妈妈互动的场景。

page_text_ocr_zh:
有的动物宝宝出生后没多久就能自己走路啦！
Some baby animals can walk soon after they're born.
而有的动物宝宝需要爸爸妈妈带上一程。
Some need a lift from mom or dad.
page_text_en:
Some baby animals can walk soon after they're born.
Some need a lift from mom or dad.
summary_zh: 本页通过长颈鹿和斑马宝宝刚出生就能行走，以及狮子妈妈用嘴叼着幼崽的例子，说明了不同动物宝宝在出生后移动能力的差异。

page_text_ocr_zh:
蹦！蹦！蹦！
你能像袋鼠那样跳跃吗？
抓紧了！
Hang on!
有的动物宝宝舒舒服服
地待在育儿袋里，和妈妈一起
蹦跳前行。有的动物宝宝骑在
妈妈背上，可要抓紧喽！
Some babies bounce along,
 snug in mother's pouch.
Other babies have to hang
 on tight!
page_text_en:
Bounce! Bounce! Bounce!
Can you hop like a kangaroo?
Hang on!
Some babies bounce along, snug in mother's pouch. Other babies have to hang on tight!
Some babies bounce along, snug in mother's pouch. Other babies have to hang on tight!
summary_zh: 本页通过袋鼠宝宝在育儿袋中和黑猩猩宝宝骑在妈妈背上的图片，说明了不同动物宝宝依附母亲移动的方式。

page_text_ocr_zh:
洗澡时间到!
Bath time!
爸爸妈妈会给你洗澡、洗头发，让你保持干净清爽。有的动物父母也会把自己的宝宝收拾得很干净，来看一看它们是怎么做的吧，别吃惊哦！
When you were a baby, your parents kept you neat and clean. They bathed you and washed your hair. Some animal parents keep their babies tidy, too. But you might be surprised by how they do it!
象妈妈用泥土给自己的宝宝洗澡，因为泥土可以保护它们的皮肤。
你是怎样把自己的皮肤和头发收拾干净的？
猴妈妈给猴宝宝理毛，帮它清除粘在身上的泥土和昆虫，让猴宝宝看起来干干净净的。
美洲狮妈妈的舌头就像一条毛巾，可以给小宝宝“洗脸”。
你猜被美洲狮的舌头舔是什么感觉？
page_text_en:
Bath time!
Bath time!
Dad and Mom will bathe and wash your hair to keep you clean and fresh. Some animal parents also keep their babies very tidy. Let's see how they do it—don't be surprised!
When you were a baby, your parents kept you neat and clean. They bathed you and washed your hair. Some animal parents keep their babies tidy, too. But you might be surprised by how they do it!
The elephant mother uses mud to bathe her baby, because mud can protect their skin.
How do you clean your skin and hair?
The monkey mother grooms her baby, removing dirt and insects stuck to its body, making the baby look clean and tidy.
The cougar mother's tongue is like a towel, and she can "wash the face" of her little baby.
Can you guess how it feels to be licked by a cougar's tongue?
summary_zh: 本页介绍了动物父母如何为宝宝清洁身体，展示了象妈妈用泥土、猴妈妈理毛、美洲狮妈妈用舌头舔舐宝宝等不同的清洁方式，并通过提问引导孩子思考。

page_text_ocr_zh:
从跳跃到攀爬，动物宝宝要学习的东西太多了……
Baby animals have a lot to learn, from jumping to climbing ...
熊宝宝锋利的爪子能帮助它们紧紧地抓住树干。你以前爬过树吗？
你能爬多高呢？能和这些熊宝宝爬得一样高吗？
page_text_en:
From jumping to climbing, baby animals have a lot to learn...
Baby animals have a lot to learn, from jumping to climbing ...
The sharp claws of baby bears help them grip the tree trunk tightly. Have you ever climbed a tree before?
How high can you climb? Can you climb as high as these baby bears?
summary_zh: 本页展示了动物宝宝学习攀爬和跳跃的场景：左侧是山羊宝宝在岩石间跳跃，右侧是熊宝宝在树干上攀爬，文字说明了它们需要学习的技能，并通过提问引导孩子思考。

page_text_ocr_zh:
有的动物宝宝要学习游泳，有的要学习飞行。
... from swimming to flying!
你猜待在冰水里是什么感觉？你想在冰水里游泳吗？
预备，站好，拍动翅膀！这只雕宝宝正在学习飞翔。为了有一天能飞离巢穴，它正在不断练习。
page_text_en:
Some baby animals need to learn to swim, others need to learn to fly.
... from swimming to flying!
What do you think it feels like to be in icy water? Would you like to swim in icy water?
Ready, set, flap! This baby eagle is learning to fly. To one day leave the nest, it is practicing constantly.
summary_zh: 本页展示了动物宝宝学习游泳和飞行的场景：左侧是鲸鱼和海豹在水中活动，右侧是雕宝宝在巢中练习飞翔，文字说明了不同动物宝宝需要掌握的生存技能。

page_text_ocr_zh:
游戏时间到啦！有的动物宝宝在树林里玩耍，从一棵树荡到另一棵树。
It’s playtime! Some babies swing and scamper through trees.
嗷呜！
Growl!
有的动物宝宝会假装打架。它们翻滚、扭打、摔跤、撕咬，通过这种方式来学习如何捕猎。
Some baby animals pretend to fight. They tumble and tussle and wrestle and bite. Pretend fighting helps baby animals learn to hunt!
page_text_en:
It's playtime! Some babies swing and scamper through trees.
Growl!
Some baby animals pretend to fight. They tumble and tussle and wrestle and bite. Pretend fighting helps baby animals learn to hunt!
summary_zh: 本页展示了动物宝宝的游戏行为：左侧是猴子宝宝在树林中荡秋千玩耍，右侧是老虎和狐狸宝宝通过假装打斗来学习捕猎技能。

page_text_ocr_zh:
轮到我啦！
My turn!
这只象宝宝是怎么把草放进自己嘴巴里的？
动物宝宝再长大一些，就要学会自己寻找食物了。当它们的妈妈在吃草、叶子或果实时，动物宝宝会在一旁仔细观察，并模仿妈妈的行为。
As they grow older, baby animals learn to find food for themselves. Some babies watch and copy their mother as she eats grass, leaves, or fruit.
试着伸长脖子，看看你能不能够到树上多汁的叶子。
有的动物宝宝要学习挖土，从地里找虫子吃。有的动物妈妈会教自己的小宝宝如何抓鱼或捕猎。
Others learn to dig for worms or bugs. Some mother animals teach their babies how to catch fish or hunt.
宝贝，看我怎么找到吃的。
这只小狐狸自己逮住了一只老鼠，开饭啦！
灰沼狸爸爸和灰沼狸妈妈在教它们的宝宝挖土找虫子吃。
page_text_en:
My turn!
How does this baby elephant put grass into its mouth?
As baby animals grow older, they learn to find food for themselves. When their mother eats grass, leaves, or fruit, the babies watch carefully and copy her behavior.
Try stretching your neck to see if you can reach the juicy leaves on the tree.
Some baby animals learn to dig for worms or bugs. Some mother animals teach their babies how to catch fish or hunt.
Baby, watch how I find food.
This little fox caught a mouse by itself. Time to eat!
The gray mongoose dad and mom are teaching their babies to dig for bugs.
summary_zh: 本页展示了动物宝宝学习觅食的过程，包括观察模仿妈妈吃草、学习挖土找虫子、以及狐狸宝宝自己捕猎等场景，强调了不同动物宝宝在成长过程中学习生存技能的方式。

page_text_ocr_zh:
这个奇妙的世界里有很多东西等着动物宝宝去探索——它们用鼻子去嗅，用爪子去摸，用嘴巴去尝……
The world is full of things for babies to explore—to sniff and touch and taste!
啊，没有什么比闻一朵香甜的花更享受的了！你喜欢闻花香吗？
page_text_en:
This wonderful world has many things waiting for animal babies to explore—they use their noses to sniff, their paws to touch, and their mouths to taste...
The world is full of things for babies to explore—to sniff and touch and taste!
Ah, nothing is more enjoyable than smelling a sweet flower! Do you like smelling flowers?
summary_zh: 本页展示了动物宝宝探索世界的方式，包括用鼻子嗅、爪子摸、嘴巴尝，并通过熊猫宝宝闻花的场景，引导孩子感受自然中的感官体验。

page_text_ocr_zh:
嘘,安静一点!
Shhh!
经过一天的学习、玩耍和探索,
动物宝宝累极了！现在，它需要睡个
好觉——就像你累了需要睡觉一样。
All that learning and playing and
exploring can make a baby tired.
Baby animals need their
sleep—just like you.
page_text_en:
Shh, be quiet!
Shhh!
After a day of learning, playing, and exploring,
the baby animal is tired! Now, it needs a good nap—just like you need sleep when you're tired.
All that learning and playing and
exploring can make a baby tired.
Baby animals need their
sleep—just like you.
summary_zh: 本页展示了一只小鹿宝宝在一天的学习、玩耍和探索后安静入睡的场景，文字说明动物宝宝和人类孩子一样，需要充足的睡眠来恢复体力。

page_text_ocr_zh:
名字游戏！
The Name Game!
在英文里，有的动物宝宝有特殊的名字。例如，企鹅宝宝叫“chick”，山羊宝宝叫“kid”。这里有更多动物宝宝和它们的特殊称呼，你能说出它们长大以后叫什么名字吗？
Some baby animals are called by special names. For example, a baby penguin is called a chick. Baby goats are called kids. Here are some more baby animals, with their special names. Can you say what the grown-up animals are called?
a. Calf
b. Foal
c. Joey
d. Fawn
e. Cub
f. Owlet
答案：a. 大象 b. 斑马 c. 袋鼠 d. 鹿 e. 狮子 f. 猫头鹰
page_text_en:
The Name Game!
In English, some baby animals have special names. For example, a baby penguin is called a chick, and baby goats are called kids. Here are more baby animals with their special names. Can you say what the grown-up animals are called?
a. Calf
b. Foal
c. Joey
d. Fawn
e. Cub
f. Owlet
Answers: a. Elephant b. Zebra c. Kangaroo d. Deer e. Lion f. Owl
summary_zh: 本页通过‘名字游戏’介绍动物幼崽的特殊名称，并引导孩子猜测其成年后的名称，配有大象、斑马、袋鼠、鹿、狮子和猫头鹰幼崽的图片及答案。
